data.title: Expose gating controls and plot gate states

data.body: Audit findings: Remaining hidden or semi-hidden knobs include DSP artifact mask threshold max(80µV, 8*MAD), artifact mask expansion 0.15s, artifact interpolation bypass when artifact_fraction >= 0.8, quality-score penalty weights for slow waves/line noise/common mode/steps/clipping/RMS, and UI-only color thresholds in signal summaries. MetricsEngine has configurable quality_gate/artifact_gate via /metrics/params, but those were not visible in the Master Feedback sidebar before this task. Created follow-up to expose artifact detector and quality scoring heuristics.

Review: Implemented visible Master Feedback gate status/controls, artifact and low-quality activation timeline rows, reward blocking during quality/artifact gate failures, and separate Master activation history so inhibits can still mute during artifacts by default. Moved broadcast rate from global Settings into Master Feedback Gates. Added regression tests for artifact blocking reward and preserving slow-wave inhibit activation. Verified python -m pytest in eeg/backend (36 passed) and npm run build in eeg/frontend (passed; Vite CJS deprecation warning only). Remaining hidden DSP artifact/quality heuristics recorded in follow-up NF-12.
